canonical_project: BDCCL Tier IV National Data Center / Meghna Cloud, Kaliakoir
owner: Bangladesh Data Center Company Limited; Gennext Technologies
notes: Meghna Cloud launched at Bangabandhu/Hi-Tech City, Kaliakoir, Gazipur, hosted in the government Tier IV National Data Center. DCD cites 200,000 sq ft and eight 2.5MW generators; Climate Watch reports total data capacity of 4MW.
